answer: One concrete Sybil defense is a bonded uniqueness registry: each agent must lock collateral and present a single non-transferable attestation before it can earn. Like a plume of smoke that cannot be split, that credential ties one identity to one payout; even a zephyr of fake accounts needs one full bond apiece. Caught fraud slashes the stake, so an attacker who spins up a saffron-hued army of clones loses every deposit at once. The cost is linear in identities: N fakes demand N bonds, and detection burns them all, outrunning any payoff they could mine.
